blurb: Binance froze $3B after a hack bigger than first thought, Arkham tracks 5.7B, Aave halts V3/V4 markets, and CZ tells Elon to stop trolling.
title: Crypto Trading Signals - October 30, 2026
top_story_headline:
🚨 Binance freezes $3B USD as hack proves bigger than a stolen laptop
Binance found more breach points, will cover all losses from SAFU and company funds, and expects withdrawals back in about 45 hours. Deposits are unaffected.
